site.name: Yes Bro
site.tagline: The newspaper for your field. News, jobs, opportunities and research, every morning.
site.promise: No accounts required to read. No tracking of what you read.
site.positioning: Yes Bro is the first field-specific newspaper: news, jobs, opportunities and research for your field, every morning. No tracking.

daily.name: Yes Bro Daily
daily.title: Daily India and world news: politics, health, space, humour | Yes Bro Daily
daily.description: Free daily newspaper for India and the world: politics, business, startups, ESG, climate, AI, health, space and science, and humour. Every headline links to the original report. No tracking.
daily.about: Yes Bro Daily is a free morning newspaper covering India and the world. It gathers politics, business, startups, climate and ESG, AI, health, space and science, and light humour, then writes short deadpan summaries with links to the original reports. Readers pick what they want without accounts or tracking.

ai.title: Daily AI news India and world | Yes Bro AI
ai.description: Daily artificial intelligence news: models and labs, AI products, AI in India, startup funding, research, chips and compute, AI at work, and safety and policy, plus AI jobs. Free. No tracking.
ai.about: Yes Bro AI is a free daily paper for anyone following artificial intelligence. It covers model launches, AI products, India AI news, funding, research papers, chips and compute, workplace AI, and safety and policy, with short summaries and links out. No launch-livestream fluff and no tracking.
